title: Taking Stock
summary:
The impact of oil market rebalancing on the tanker market
When OPEC announced their first production cuts in eight years in September 2016, it was clear that the key objective was to drain record global oil inventories and bring a certain balance back to the oil markets. OPEC hoped that this would lead to a recovery in oil prices. The original six-month deal started on January 1, 2017 and cut a combined 1.8 million of production from OPEC and select non-OPEC producers (including Russia).
